name: Kathy Manning
bio: a Representative from North Carolina; born in Detroit, Wayne County, Mich., December 3, 1956; graduated from Ernest W. Seaholm High School, Birmingham, Mich., 1974; A.B., Harvard University, Cambridge, Mass., 1978; J.D., University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, Mich., 1981; lawyer, private practice; unsuccessful candidate for election to the One Hundred Sixteenth Congress in 2018; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Seventeenth and to the succeeding Congress (January 3, 2021-January 3, 2025); was not a candidate for reelection to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress in 2024.
